protocol.target: next broker-day log return, volatility-scaled for fitting
protocol.ic: daily cross-sectional Pearson of forecast vs realised next-day return, mean and t over days
protocol.portfolio: dollar-neutral, demeaned forecast ranks / sigma_t, gross 1, daily rebalance; cost = |dw| x (half the day's median H1 spread from the bars' spread column / price + 0.25bp commission) per side
protocol.no_tuning: every constant and both grids were fixed before the first run; every configuration is reported and charged

gnn.verdict: NO_GAIN: IC t 0.019 < 2; net Sharpe -1.067 not > 0 and above baseline (directionally above baseline on ic_mean, ls_sharpe_net, not significant)

attention.verdict: NO_GAIN: IC t 0.002 < 2; net Sharpe -0.709 not > 0 and above baseline (directionally above baseline on ic_mean, ls_sharpe_net, not significant)

falsification_control.what: gnn primary on a panel with each instrument's returns permuted in time

gnn.not_screened_reason: tried and CHARGED, but too few forecast signals cleared the entry threshold on the walk-forward window for the screen to score them (the symbol's bar history in git is shorter than the panel's)

attention.not_screened_reason: tried and CHARGED, but too few forecast signals cleared the entry threshold on the walk-forward window for the screen to score them (the symbol's bar history in git is shorter than the panel's)

union_headline.rule: each miner's best t deflated over the UNION of every test both miners ran

trials_charged.cell_level: the miner charges configs x symbols x 2 entry thresholds per model = 192 per miner run
